method: Estimate production selected transitions on all author images, without labels. Score published adjacent labels when both endpoints are retained. For each selected nonadjacent bridge, also score distinct feature endpoints connected by exact (view,x,y) author label equality, retaining annotation line provenance.
limitations: Development data, not held-out accuracy. Chained endpoints are correlated with existing labels and each other. Exact joins may miss the same feature labelled at slightly different pixels. Unlabelled bridges remain unverified. Derived nonblack masks, not silhouette truth. No defect or tracker validation.
